reports.title: Elaine Jobe
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust has Best Practice and Consistency of Recording on Rio for inpatient services, which includes risk assessments. Within 7 hours of admission, a risk assessment is completed by the admitting nurse and doctor. The time and names of the staff completing the assessment are automatically generated and inputted by the electronic patient record system on Rio.
promises.summary: Risk assessments completed within 7 hours of admission and logged electronically.

promises.quote: The Entry and Exit Policy is under review, it will be revised to support a 'locked door' policy with a clear expectation of how to ensure that the restriction in movement does not impact on individual's right to exit. It is anticipated that policy ratification will be sought at Senior Management Board on 10/2/17
promises.summary: Review Entry and Exit Policy to enforce locked doors on all in-patient units

promises.quote: LED signs for doors have been ordered and we are waiting for them to be delivered and installed. These are due to be installed within the next month
promises.summary: Install LED signs on doors to indicate locked status

promises.quote: The revised policy will be published in January 2017 across the Trust and will be shared directly with colleagues in the Adult Directorate in its Directorate Bulletin in January 2017
promises.summary: Publish revised Engagement Policy to address unpredictable observations

promises.quote: The form used for recording observations had been changed at the time of the inquest and now requires the specific time of observation to be recorded on the form for each patient
promises.summary: Require specific time of observation on forms to avoid predictable intervals

promises.quote: A new system of note recording has been introduced since this death, but it still does not make obtaining information from carers and / or family mandatory on admission
promises.summary: Introduce mandatory fields in Care Notes to capture carer information
